title: Enterprise Feature Hopper — Sales/CS Intake Prioritizer & Mini-PRD Generator
creator: Devon Malik
description: Build a lightweight process + automation (the 'Feature Hopper') that aggregates Sales/CS enterprise asks into prioritized bundles and emits a one-page Mini-PRD for rapid scoping. This ticket covers the initial design, acceptance criteria, and a first-pass automation prototype that ingests intake rows from the CS intake form, enriches them with account metadata (ARR band, region, contractual constraints), and outputs ranked bundles plus a generated Mini-PRD for the top 3 bundles. The goal is to reduce manual triage time for PMs by ~60% and standardize the first-pass economics and technical assumptions used in enterprise scoping.
scope_in_scope: - Aggregation rules for grouping related asks by account, capability, and effort; - Prioritization heuristics combining account value, urgency, cust-request frequency, technical lift estimate; - Mini-PRD template generator (one page) with acceptance criteria, rough implementation notes, risk flags; - Integration with existing CS intake Google Sheet and Salesforce extracts; - Export to Confluence and creation of Linear stub tickets for top bundles.
scope_out_of_scope: - Detailed engineering estimates or full PRDs; - Automated entitlement checks (will surface flags but not enforce); - Full SLA/contract changes; - On-prem deployment support for the automation prototype.
approach: 1) Define data schema and enrichment fields (account tiers, product areas, impacted endpoints). 2) Implement deterministic grouping rules (fuzzy title match + taxonomy mapping). 3) Compute prioritization score (weighted sum: account_value 40%, ask_frequency 25%, urgency 20%, technical_risk 15%). 4) Generate Mini-PRD text using a template with slots filled from enriched fields; include suggested rollout strategy (canary/alpha cohorts). 5) Produce UI/CSV output and create Linear stubs for follow-up. 6) Run a 2-week pilot with Sales/CS partners on a 50-account sample.
tradeoffs_and_considerations: - Heuristic prioritization will not replace human judgment; we need clear override flows for AMs and PMs. - Fuzzy grouping reduces duplicate tickets but risks over-aggregating unrelated asks; threshold tuning required. - Mini-PRD must be short to be useful; too much automation detail will be ignored by PMs. - Initial prototype will be read-only; later iteration could allow inline edits.
acceptance_criteria: Ingests CS intake rows and enriches with account metadata for 95% of rows in pilot sample.
Groups related asks into bundles with a precision >= 0.7 (manual review benchmark).
Produces a Mini-PRD for top 3 bundles per week, each containing: summary, business value, suggested scope, rough effort band, key risks, recommended next step.
Automated creation of Linear stub tickets for each top bundle with links to source rows and generated Mini-PRD.
Pilot feedback: median triage time reduced by >40% for participating PMs/AMs.
Privacy: no PII exported in generated docs; conforms to Data Handling guidelines.

2025-02-28: Mini-PRD template drafted in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Feature+Hopper+Mini-PRD+Template. Template fields approved by product leads. Action: add 'regulatory_constraints' slot for EU accounts.

2025-03-02: Pilot kickoff scheduled. CS cohort selected (50 accounts). Dashboards for pilot tracking created: https://analytics.redwood.ai/d/pilot/feature-hopper. Next steps: run pilot ingestion and collect triage time metrics; follow-up review on 2025-03-16.

Planned follow-ups: - Add manual override UI for bundle merges (PM-74269). - Implement weighting config in console for prioritization heuristics (ENG-4821). - Post-pilot retro to decide on rollout and resource commit.
risks: Over-aggregation: unrelated asks bundled due to limited taxonomy; mitigation: manual merge/undo and threshold tuning.
Data quality: missing account metadata reduces enrichment accuracy; mitigation: require account_id for pilot ingestion and surface rows needing manual fill.
Adoption: PMs/AMs may not trust automated scores; mitigation: show score decomposition and provenance for each field.
notes_for_engineering: ENG support requested: 2 sprint-days for prototype integration, an API endpoint that returns bundles for a given CSV, and a Linear API client to create stubs. Provide a lightweight config (JSON) to tune weights. Privacy: strip PII before sending to any external NLP service.
